jobs.summary: Junior Yardi Consultant will support Yardi implementations and system configuration for international real estate clients through hands-on project work. The role exists to ensure accurate data migrations and smooth go-lives while developing ERP and finance process expertise.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu ABOUT US Stellar Advisory is an international consultancy and software company specialising in real estate technology and a leading Yardi implementation partner in the Netherlands. We support some of the largest real estate owners and asset managers in the Netherlands and across Europe, with several of our clients managing portfolios exceeding 1,000,000 m². ABOUT THE ROLE Stellar Advisory supports real estate organisations with Yardi implementations, system optimisation, data migration, business intelligence and ongoing support. Our teams operate from Amsterdam and Novi Sad. We are looking for a Junior Yardi Consultant who is interested in ERP systems and wants to develop into a Yardi specialist. You will support projects for international real estate clients and build your expertise through hands-on project work, working closely with experienced consultants. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys understanding business processes, has an interest in finance and technology, and wants to build a career in ERP consulting and support. Previous Yardi experience is not required, but curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn are essential. Key responsibilities Support Yardi implementation projects alongside experienced consultants. Assist with mapping business processes to system functionality and configuration. Help configure workflows and set up lease administration. Support system testing by identifying, documenting and helping resolve issues. Assist with data migrations, including creating, testing and troubleshooting ETL data imports under the guidance of experienced consultants. Help prepare system documentation and end-user training materials. Support go-live preparation and implementation activities. Contribute to improvements after go-live and help investigate and resolve support tickets through our ticketing system. Do you want to build and maintain high-performing marketing pages using a framework-light architecture while avoiding unnecessary reinvention? If yes, then this could be your next favorite role. We’re looking for a Front-End Developer to join our remote team and help implement and evolve our marketing website. Who is Digistore24? Here at Digistore24, we create client success. Our mission is to empower limitless success for digital entrepreneurs through innovation, connection, and growth, helping them reach their audiences by automating and digitalizing the complete sales process: from order forms, invoices, affiliates, payment processes, and statistics to accounting and conversion optimization. Eklektika, a company from Belgrade, has existed for 20 years and recently became an integral part of the German/USA company Digistore24. Digistore24 is a global affiliate marketplace connecting offer owners and affiliates across digital products, subscriptions, services, and online business models, operating in ecosystems where visibility, trust, and speed matter. Your Mission: This is not your average developer role. In fact, this is not a React, Vue, Tailwind, or Bootstrap role. Our marketing site is intentionally framework-light, relying on Astro for fully static output, Sanity as a headless CMS for structured content and translations, and vanilla JavaScript and CSS for front-end behavior and styling. Your mission is to ensure our marketing website communicates our ambition through a clear, high-performing, and consistent digital experience. You’ll initially focus on content development within Sanity Studio, using existing Custom Code components and our established ds24-prefixed architecture. As your familiarity with the platform grows, you will expand into translating approved designs into reusable, production-ready Astro sections, templates, and page components. Success in this position depends less on familiarity with a specific framework and more on strong fundamentals, sound engineering judgment, and the discipline to extend existing conventions rather than creating competing patterns. Responsibilities: Implementing and maintaining marketing pages using existing Sanity page-builder sections, content models, and Custom Code components. Building responsive interfaces with semantic HTML, modern vanilla CSS, and purposeful vanilla JavaScript, keeping performance and maintainability central to every implementation. Gradually expanding into writing GROQ queries to retrieve the content required by pages and components. Applying the established Digistore24 design system and section structure consistently, improving existing patterns only through appropriate architectural and review processes. Validating work thoroughly across breakpoints and supported browsers to identify and resolve visual, responsive, accessibility, and functional issues before release.
